XR Kitchen Han Regular is a subset of Noto Sans SC for the kitchen UI. It uses the static weight 500 and covers GB 2312 plus interface characters. The derivative uses a new family name. OFL.txt contains the upstream license.

Upstream variable font SHA-256 a3041811a78c361b1de50f953c805e0244951c21c5bd412f7232ef0d899af0da
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
